---
title: "10. Twelve Days of Christmas"
body-classes: lyrics day-reveal has-chords
---

::: {#verse .day-verse}
[<span class="cw">On the </span><span class="cw"><span class="ch">D</span><span id="day-ordinal">first</span> day of </span><span class="cw"><span class="ch">Bm</span>Christmas,</span>]{#day-opening}
[<span class="cw">My </span><span class="cw"><span class="ch">Em</span>true love </span><span class="cw"><span class="ch">A</span>sent to </span><span class="cw"><span class="ch">D</span>me</span>]{.ln}
[<span class="cw"><span class="ch">A</span>Twelve drummers drumming,</span>]{.gift day="12"}
[<span class="cw"><span class="ch">A</span>Eleven pipers piping,</span>]{.gift day="11"}
[<span class="cw"><span class="ch">A</span>Ten lords a-leaping,</span>]{.gift day="10"}
[<span class="cw"><span class="ch">A</span>Nine ladies dancing,</span>]{.gift day="9"}
[<span class="cw"><span class="ch">A</span>Eight maids a-milking,</span>]{.gift day="8"}
[<span class="cw"><span class="ch">A</span>Seven swans a-swimming,</span>]{.gift day="7"}
[<span class="cw"><span class="ch">A</span>Six geese a-laying,</span>]{.gift day="6"}
[<span class="cw"><span class="ch">D</span>Five </span><span class="cw"><span class="ch">E</span>golden </span><span class="cw"><span class="ch">A</span>rings,</span>]{.gift day="5"}
[<span class="cw"><span class="ch">A</span>Four calling birds,</span>]{.gift day="4" from="1" until="4"}
[<span class="cw"><span class="ch">D</span>Four calling birds,</span>]{.gift day="4" from="5" until="12"}
[<span class="cw"><span class="ch">A</span>Three French hens,</span>]{.gift day="3" from="1" until="4"}
[<span class="cw"><span class="ch">Bm</span>Three French hens,</span>]{.gift day="3" from="5" until="12"}
[<span class="cw"><span class="ch">A</span>Two turtle doves,</span>]{.gift day="2" from="1" until="4"}
[<span class="cw"><span class="ch">E</span>Two turtle </span><span class="cw"><span class="ch">A</span>doves,</span>]{.gift day="2" from="5" until="12"}
[<span class="cw">A </span><span class="nb"><span class="cw"><span class="ch">D/F#</span>partr</span><span class="cw"><span class="ch">G</span>idge </span></span><span class="cw"><span class="ch">D/A</span>in a </span><span class="cw"><span class="ch">A</span>pear </span><span class="cw"><span class="ch">D</span>tree!</span>]{.gift day="1" from="1" until="1"}
[<span class="cw">And a </span><span class="nb"><span class="cw"><span class="ch">D/F#</span>partr</span><span class="cw"><span class="ch">G</span>idge </span></span><span class="cw"><span class="ch">D/A</span>in a </span><span class="cw"><span class="ch">A</span>pear </span><span class="cw"><span class="ch">D</span>tree!</span>]{.gift day="1" from="2" until="12"}
:::
